title: About Dzvin.co
intro: Dzvin.co is a Ukrainian personal self-support service: quick state check-ins, a private diary and short exercises you can choose at your own pace.
introExtended: The service is at an early stage (beta). Available today: daily check-ins for stress, mood, energy and focus, a private diary, breathing and calming exercises, meditations and tips, plus personal progress and goals. For companies and research teams we are developing separate pilot formats with clear access boundaries. Dzvin.co does not diagnose and does not replace a professional.

Evolution.title: From a single check-in to a manageable next step
Evolution.description: Dzvin.co does not predict your state or judge it. It helps you notice how you feel, pick a short practice and come back to your own history at your own pace.

stepDescriptions.happened: You rate stress, mood, energy or focus, or write a diary entry — whenever it suits you.
stepDescriptions.means: The service shows what you recorded today, with no diagnoses, rankings or comparison with other people.
stepDescriptions.next: In the guide you choose a short practice: breathing, calming, a meditation or a tip.
stepDescriptions.action: You decide: do the exercise, pick another one or simply come back later.
stepDescriptions.evidence: My Progress shows your check-in statistics, goals and achievements — no streaks and no penalties for missed days.

context.title: Your rhythm, your choice
context.description: Every step is optional: start with a check-in, a diary entry or a short exercise.

signal.title: Check-in
signal.description: A few ratings on a 1–5 scale or a free-form diary entry.

prediction.title: Practice
prediction.description: A short exercise from the guide that you choose yourself — not a forecast or a conclusion about your state.

validation.title: Your history
validation.description: Entries and statistics you can return to in order to notice changes over time.

business.title: For companies
business.description: Personal self-support for employees and pilot organizational formats based on aggregated data. Employers have no access to private diaries or check-ins. Company features are not launched yet — we discuss pilots individually.

user.title: For yourself
user.description: State check-ins, a private diary, short exercises and personal progress — no mandatory tests, streaks or pressure.

research.title: For researchers
research.description: Open to joint research protocols with universities and institutes. Any study requires separate participant consent and ethics approval.

Architecture.title: How Dzvin.co is organized
Architecture.overviewDescription: The personal service, company pilots and the research track are developed separately, each with its own data access boundaries.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionLead: The personal service, company pilots and the research track are developed separately, each with its own data access boundaries.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionFollowup: Personal records belong to the user and are not shared with companies or researchers without separate explicit consent.
Architecture.interactionHint: Choose a track from the chips or click the card on the right to learn more.

core.title: Research track
core.description: We are researching how QDIP decision-support methods could help choose appropriate actions. This is research, not a feature available to users.

b2c.title: Personal space
b2c.description: State check-ins, diary, exercises, goals and progress — available now in beta.

loop.title: Data boundaries
loop.description: Sign-in through a secured account and owner-only access to personal records.

Value.title: What matters to us
Value.description: We are building a service that supports rather than evaluates, and we are honest about what already works and what is still in development.

points.cohort: Personal records stay personal: no comparison with other people and no employer access.
points.explainable: Every step is optional: no mandatory tests, streaks or pressure — the decision is always yours.
points.outcome: The service does not diagnose or promise clinical outcomes. In a crisis, contact a professional or emergency services.
